ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there are two circles, the circle on the left has C as its center, and the circle on the right has D as its center. In the left circle there is chord KL, there is a pink tick mark on the chord, and arc KL is labeled as 5x°. In the right circle there is chord AJ, there is also the same pink tick mark on the chord, and arc AJ is labeled as (3x+54)°. Reasoning: The problem gives ⊙C ≅ ⊙D, so the two circles are congruent. In the figure chord KL and chord AJ have the same tick mark, indicating KL ≅ AJ. In congruent circles, the arcs intercepted by congruent chords are also congruent, so the measures of the corresponding arcs are equal: 5x = 3x + 54. Solving gives 2x = 54, so x = 27.
